name: Tianjin MR-fluid
full_name: Tianjin master-slave interventional robot with MR-fluid passive haptic interface (catheter + guidewire simultaneously)
group: Tianjin University of Technology, Tianjin Key Laboratory for Control Theory and Applications (Yu Song, Yu Tian, Lin Li) with South China Agricultural University (Xuanchun Yin); Song Yu previously at Kagawa
versions: song2018_performance (Biomed Microdevices 2018, Kagawa-era catheter operating system with haptics) -> song2023_masterslave (Sensors 2023) -> song2025_passive (MBEC 2025, passive haptic interface, abstract not read)
target_anatomy: 1:1 in vitro vessel model with circulating pump (song2023_masterslave Sec. 4.3, Figs. 17-18)
translation_detail: friction-roller + clamp hybrid: catheter clamped by a solenoid gripper and pushed by a stepper-driven slide (clamp + stage); guidewire between an active and an electromagnet-pressed driven friction wheel on a stepper; a solenoid guidewire-support clamp holds the wire while the catheter advances (Sec. 3.2.1-3.2.2, Figs. 11-12)
rotation_detail: catheter only: the clamps of the catheter unit grip and a stepper motor rotates them (Sec. 3.2.2); guidewire not rotated
force_sensing: catheter resistance: the gripper floats between four force sensors and touches them under load (Sec. 3.2.1); reflected to the MRF master
haptics_leader: MRF passive haptic interface with a rigid catheter as handle: axial motion read by a Hall encoder through a removable friction wheel, rotation through a rotating tube with encoder; the force-feedback friction wheel is braked by MR fluid (Sec. 3.1)
validation_detail: bench: 1000 mm deliveries at 5-30 mm/s, 10 repeats per speed (Sec. 4.2, Fig. 15); phantom: surgeon at the master in an isolated room driving catheter and guidewire through a 1:1 in vitro model with circulating pump (Sec. 4.3, Figs. 17-18)
key_numbers: catheter axial delivery error mean 0.95 mm, max < 2.0 mm; guidewire mean 1 mm, max < 2.0 mm over 1000 mm at 5-30 mm/s (Sec. 4.2)
